tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Read current free offer, category IDs and payment boundaries.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Read-only optional bid quote. Creates no payment and reserves no rank.

tools.name: publish_free
tools.description: Creates ONE real public free listing after explicit user approval. Save the supplied UUID and 32-byte secret securely BEFORE calling. Identical retries only. Response contains private reusable management credentials; never print them publicly. Does not charge money.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "publish_free" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
